test.name: Hints cannot be read: the hints item is skipped as inaccessible, with no log entry
test.description: The router hands search-hints the planned hints item pli_007 for Patrick Flynn (LZNY-BRF), and person_record_matches refuses: there is no FamilySearch session. The hints cannot be read, so triage sets pli_007 skipped with skip_category inaccessible and a skip_reason naming why. A skip needs no log entry. It does not guess at hints it could not read (issue #3153).

input.delegation:
Review the pending FamilySearch hints on Patrick Flynn for plan item pli_007.

personId: LZNY-BRF
planItemId: pli_007
planId: pl_002
projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: person_record_matches returns an error: the user is not logged in to FamilySearch. The hints could not be read; that is not the same as there being no hints
The hints item pli_007 ends skipped, skip_category inaccessible, with a skip_reason naming the refusal, written through research_append on plan_items
No log entry is written, and in particular no negative entry claiming there are no hints
No hint lines or recommendations are invented for hints that were never read
Telling the researcher that logging in to FamilySearch would let the hints be reviewed is good; calling a login tool is not expected
